assertions.description: getContext('2d', settings) reads the toneMapping member of CanvasRenderingContext2DSettings (a getter on it is invoked during dictionary conversion).
With no toneMapping setting, getContextAttributes().toneMapping.mode is "standard".
toneMapping: {} defaults mode to "standard" in the reflected settings.
toneMapping: {mode: "extended"} on an HTMLCanvasElement 2D context is reflected as "extended" by getContextAttributes().
toneMapping: {mode: "extended"} on an OffscreenCanvas 2D context is reflected as "extended" by getContextAttributes().
A mode outside the CanvasToneMappingMode enum ("standard", "extended") makes getContext throw a TypeError.
Tone mapping applies at display time only: a float16 canvas created with "extended" stores and returns a 4.0 channel value unchanged from getImageData.
An "extended" srgb-linear float16 canvas filled with 16x SDR white encodes to PNG (convertToBlob) and decodes back to ~16, as in WPT encode-hdr.html.
assertions.test: (async()=>{const s=new OffscreenCanvas(16,16).getContext('2d',{colorSpace:'srgb-linear',colorType:'float16',toneMapping:{mode:'extended'}});s.fillStyle='color(srgb-linear 16 16 16)';s.fillRect(0,0,16,16);const b=await s.canvas.convertToBlob({type:'image/png'});const i=await createImageBitmap(b);const d=new OffscreenCanvas(16,16).getContext('2d',{colorSpace:'srgb-linear',colorType:'float16'});d.drawImage(i,0,0);const v=d.getImageData(8,8,1,1,{colorSpace:'srgb-linear',pixelFormat:'rgba-float16'}).data[0];return Math.abs(v-16)<=1;})()

assertions.description: A "standard" srgb-linear float16 canvas filled with 16x SDR white encodes to PNG and decodes back to ~1 (maximum SDR precision), as in WPT encode-hdr.html.
assertions.test: (async()=>{const s=new OffscreenCanvas(16,16).getContext('2d',{colorSpace:'srgb-linear',colorType:'float16',toneMapping:{mode:'standard'}});s.fillStyle='color(srgb-linear 16 16 16)';s.fillRect(0,0,16,16);const b=await s.canvas.convertToBlob({type:'image/png'});const i=await createImageBitmap(b);const d=new OffscreenCanvas(16,16).getContext('2d',{colorSpace:'srgb-linear',colorType:'float16'});d.drawImage(i,0,0);const v=d.getImageData(8,8,1,1,{colorSpace:'srgb-linear',pixelFormat:'rgba-float16'}).data[0];return Math.abs(v-1)<=0.05;})()
